== Overview ==

Flameshot lives up to its official slogan:

<blockquote>
{{#statements:P42}}
</blockquote>

== Features ==

* Region / full-screen / window capture via CLI&GUI
* Built-in annotation tools (draw, highlight, blur, arrow, text)
* Save, copy to clipboard, or upload to external image hosts
* Configurable via CLI&GUI

== Alternatives ==

* '''gnome-screenshot''' — simple, GNOME-native
* '''Spectacle''' — KDE Plasma's screenshot tool
* '''Ksnip''' — annotation-focused, Windows/Linux
